title: Special Edition: The Spear Hero
paragraphs: The Spear Hero: A Slight Sneak Peek at What’s to Come (Hypothetical)
The Dark Saint Hero <DARK Brave> Squad
“Where did Keel go? I haven’t seen him since this morning…”
Father asks Big Sister in the cafeteria.
“Um… for a while now, he’s been waiting in the corner of the cafeteria with the Sword Hero and Black Thunder, either waiting to cook or just hanging out.”
“It’s not like they’re Motoyasu and Filolial…”
Just as Father sighs, perhaps because their location has been pinpointed, Ren, Black Thunder, and Keel abruptly break their stealth and appear, striking a pose.
“It seems the karma of our past lives has brought us together once again…”
As usual, Ren seems to be having fun playing with Black Thunder. He’s covering his right eye with his left hand, his elbow bent at a strange angle, and giving us a sidelong glance.
“Filolial Mask No. 4, here I am!”
Keel is striking a mysterious pose as well. He’s wearing something that looks just like the mask I’m wearing.
“Hahaha! The Jet-Black Twin Fangs have arrived!”
Black Thunder is also striking a pose behind Ren, covering his left eye.
“Darkness S'yne!”
“‘We are! The Darkness Brave Squad!’”
There was a small explosion behind us—*boom*.
“…Sigh. These guys… If they want to eat, they should just say so… Instead, they’ve gone and moved in on their own. They’re seriously trouble, these guys…”
“Keel-kun has started getting involved…”
“He’s totally just the mascot now. I mean, waiting for us to come out? Do you guys have nothing better to do…?”
I should join in here too! Sizzle!
“The Filolial Mask has arrived! Kueeeee! That’s right!”
“Motoyasu’s jumping on the bandwagon and pulling pranks too… Seriously, these Mystery Justice Squad guys are exhausting…”
“Ha ha ha! We’re the Filolial Rangers!”
“Hmph… Nope. We’re the Dark Brave Squad.”
“Even though Number 4’s mixed in here.”
That’s Father’s retort.
“I guess it’s for the best that Filolial Mask Numbers 2 and 3 aren’t here… Rishia, you’ll have to find out what Numbers 2 and 3 are up to.”
“Why don’t you join in too, Father? How about Big Sister?”
“I don’t like that vibe.”
“Someone… go get Filo-tan. At the very least, shut Motoyasu up.”
Eek!? Is Filo-tan coming!?
Flag Breaker Itsuki
Itsuki is being led away by the school dorm’s pig of a dorm supervisor.
“Since I have teleportation skills, I don’t really need to live in the dorm…”
“Oink, oink, oink, oink, oink, oink, oink.”

It seems the pig is explaining something to him. With a sigh, Itsuki arrives in front of the room assigned to him. Then, without haste, he placed his hand on the doorknob… and after mimicking the pig’s military-style move of pressing his ear against the door—for some reason—Itsuki asked the pig,
“This is supposed to be my room, right? There shouldn’t be anyone inside, should there?”
“O-oink… oink-oink-oink”
“I see… which means—”
He transformed the bow he was holding into a firearm—a grenade launcher—and after hurriedly opening the door, he fired.
“Paralyzing Smoke Shot!”
With a “Bash!” as Itsuki fired the round, he slammed the door shut. A “whoosh” echoed as smoke billowed out from inside the room.
“Ooogggghhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!?”
The pig’s squeal reverberated through the room, then gradually faded away.
“Ooog, ooog…”
“I had a bad feeling about this, so it was the right call to do this just in case.”
When the door opened and the smoke cleared, there lay a completely naked pig—who looked like he’d just gotten out of the shower—collapsed on the floor.
“O… Oo-oink? Oo-oo-oo…”
Itsuki tried his best not to look. The dorm leader pig entered the room and draped a towel over the naked pig.
“I suppose since the room had been vacant for quite some time, he was using it as a makeshift changing room, wasn’t he?”
“O-o-o-o-o… O-o-o-o…”

The dorm leader cast a healing spell to cure the paralysis afflicting the collapsed pig. It seems there’s no doubt this is indeed the world-renowned school of Magic. As expected of an academy that admitted the Magic Shop Owner who helped Father out in so many ways. It seems the Pig Dorm Leader is fully equipped with healing magic as well.
“Oink, oink-oink! Oink-oink!”
“Well… even if you boast about your family background and grades… I’m the Bow Hero among the Four Sacred Heroes, so I’m far above that.”
“B, Buhi? Bububu! Bubuhi, Bubuhi!”

The pig looked momentarily dumbfounded, but immediately snapped back to his senses and started shouting while pointing at Itsuki. This vibe… I seem to remember it vaguely. I suspect I’ve been ordered to take part in some kind of mysterious contest.
“Bububu… Buhi! Boo-boo!”
At that moment, the dorm leader pig yelled at the naked pig in a loud voice.

“Shouldn’t you first report the unauthorized use of a school room to the school representative? Also, just because you took part in a contest doesn’t mean your offense will be forgotten. In fact, you’ll be suspected of trying to scheme against me in the first place, so I think it would be better for your future if you just left the room right now.”

Yelled at by the Dorm Leader Pig and cut down without mercy by Itsuki, the Naked Pig’s face turned even redder, and he began to scream. Hearing the commotion, the Academy Principal literally came flying in.
“What on earth are you doing! Who do you think this person is?!　She’s the Bow Hero—one of the Four Holy Heroes who saved the world from the Waves!”
“O-o-o-oink!?”
After being yelled at by the principal, even the completely naked pig seemed to realize the gravity of the situation.

“I thought you were a model student… but I’m disappointed. As for the expulsion you’ve been making such a fuss about, that’s something you’ll have to handle yourself. Stop doing things that will make your parents sad.”
“Now, now, Principal… I do think she’s a bit of a troublemaker, but it would be a shame to cut her off from her future… If she stays away from me, I’ll let it slide, so please show her some mercy.”
“If the Bow Hero says so… then you’d better thank the Bow Hero. Now, get out of here.”
“O-o-oink!”
Powerless to resist, the pig left the room, letting out a frustrated squeal.
“I’m truly sorry to have dragged you into such an incident right after you arrived.”
“Don’t worry about it. I had a feeling this might happen…”
Saying that, Itsuki walked over to the room’s balcony… and slowly switched the bow—which had been set to a grenade launcher—back to a handgun—
“Oink—”

With a *bang*, he shot the pig right between the eyes as it fell, knocking it away so it wouldn’t get caught on the railing. Just before the pig, having been shot, was about to crash to the ground with a *thud*, it floated in the air for a moment before landing. It seems its gear was designed to harness the wind.
“That breaks the pattern… I wonder where the next one will come from?”
“W-well, it seems the Bow Hero is quite thorough in his preparations.”
“Well, there was someone who scattered hints left and right… Anyway, I’m going to get some rest in my room now.”
“Yes… Please take your time…”
Saying that, the school principal and the dorm supervisor pig left the room.
“Well then… I know you’re hiding somewhere, so please come out.”
“Tch! I set the stage for this, and now it’s turning out to be such a boring development. Seriously!”
Rival, who was with me, clicked his tongue.
“Itsuki… it’s no fun if you squash the foreshadowing, is it…?”
Father protested to Itsuki right then and there.
“So you were hiding after all… It’s fine, though. I don’t need that kind of cliché from you. Seriously… I guess there really was a reason Gaelion-san was pushing you so hard for no good reason.”
“Itsuki… You really should stick to the clichés. I mean, you’re a pig, after all.”
This kind of commotion was an everyday occurrence for me, too! But since I’m a pig, I don’t even feel like doing it!
“For once, please stop teasing me—starting with that future robot-like thing that showed up the other day. Gaelion!”
“Gaelion wasn’t the one leading him on.”
“Itsuki, isn’t that rude to Raph…?”
